purpose: Trace Offer338mW-to22kHz saturation/dipole/polarization conventions without modifying production physics or diagram.

sourceFacts.fact: PhiO=Gamma/vz*sqrt(P0/Isat)*exp[-(Delta-kvx)^2*tau^2/4]; Gamma is outside the square root. Fig.1 gives Gamma/(2pi)=10mHz. Reference33 is Strathearn2023;34 is Foot2004.

sourceFacts.location: PDF p.2 Sec1.2 lines28-38; p.3 Sec1.3 lines56-63
sourceFacts.fact: 1070mW available for RB stage; linear polarization addresses both mF initial states. P0=338mW is selected to fit Doppler contrast at95m/s, corresponding to peak2pi*22kHz.

Hamiltonian off-diagonal is OmegaS, so physical OmegaR=2OmegaS; actual Bloch pulse area is2PhiS. Amplitude is normalized by target area A. No numerical Yb Isat/dipole/CG or physical laser power is supplied. Examples use40Ca657nm.
Yb clock transition is tabulated as578.4nm and10mHz; the inspected Yb material does not supply a7.6mHz or21s author input.20.6s elsewhere is27Al+, not Yb.
